Explain recursion

Recursion is when a function calls itself on a smaller input. Each call is pushed on the call stack until a base case returns; then the stack unwinds. Recurrences like T(n)=T(n-1)+O(1) describe the cost, and tail-call optimisation can remove stack growth in some languages.

What is Kubernetes?

Kubernetes is an open-source container orchestration platform. It schedules containers onto a cluster of machines, restarts failed ones, scales them with load, balances traffic between them and rolls out new versions without downtime. It is configured with YAML manifests that describe the desired state, and controllers keep the cluster in that state.
